'''Oz''' was a [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] who served in the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[Torrent Company/Legends|Torrent Company]], a [[Company/Legends|unit]] of the [[501st Legion/Legends|501st Legion]], during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Around [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]], after [[Battle of Ereesus|defending]] the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ereesus]] against a [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] invasion, Oz and the 501st fought in a [[Battle of Umbara/Legends|campaign]] to reconquer the formerly Republic-aligned world of [[Umbara/Legends|Umbara]]. After a rough landing on the planet's surface, Oz and [[Gender/Legends|his]] comrades met heavy resistance from the [[Umbaran militia]]. While on a [[Umbara capital main road/Legends|highway]] that led to the [[Umbaran capital city/Legends|Umbaran capital]], Oz and fellow [[Trooper/Legends|trooper]] [[Ringo/Legends|Ringo]] stepped on a [[Mine/Legends|mine]] and were [[Death/Legends|killed]] in the resulting explosion.

==Biography==
The [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] who adopted the name Oz,<ref name="DOU" /> a [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] of the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]], was [[Reproduction/Legends|born]] and raised on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]] to serve in the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].<ref name="clone troopers" /> Around [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]],<ref name="Date" /> Oz served in the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic's]]<ref name="DOU" /> [[Torrent Company/Legends|Torrent Company]]<ref name="Speaking Silently" /> of the [[501st Legion/Legends|501st Legion]] under [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]]<ref name="DOU" /> and [[Clone Captain/Legends|Clone Captain]] [[Rex/Legends|CT-7567]], nicknamed "Rex." During that [[Time/Legends|time]] Torrent [[Company/Legends|Company]] was sent to the planet [[Ereesus]], where the clones assisted the local [[Ereesus Planetary Security Forces]] in [[Battle of Ereesus|defending]] the world against a [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederate]] invasion. Oz served as a liaison between Torrent Company and the Planetary Security forces. During the campaign the Separatists captured Oz and a local militia [[Squad/Legends|squad]] led by Planetary Security Forces [[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] [[Palola]]. The [[Unidentified T-series tactical droid (Ereesus)|tactical droid]] commanding the Separatists showcased [[Gender/Legends|his]] [[Prison/Legends|prisoners]] in a [[Hologram/Legends|holotransmission]] sent to Rex to make certain demands of the Republic forces. However, [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Sollaw ap-Orwien]] of the local militiamen was able to decipher several key points of intelligence that Palola surreptitiously provided during the holorecording, as they were both [[Lorrdian/Legends|Lorrdian]], a [[Species/Legends|species]] able to [[Kinetic communication|communicate without speaking]]. Ap-Orwien was therefore able to pinpoint from Palola the location of the captives, and a team led by Rex successfully rescued Oz and the local squad.<ref name="Speaking Silently" />

Sometime later, the Republic sent a strike force, including Oz and the 501st, to [[Battle of Umbara/Legends|reconquer]] the former Republic planet [[Umbara/Legends|Umbara]]. The Republic's goal was to capture the [[Umbaran capital city/Legends|Umbaran capital city]], and Oz and his [[unit]] were dispatched to attack [[Umbaran militia|Umbaran troops]] north of the [[City/Legends|city]]. After landing roughly on the surface of Umbara, Oz and his brothers immediately engaged the [[Homeworld/Legends|native]] [[Umbaran/Legends|Umbaran]] [[Troop/Legends|troops]] in a tough [[Lightfight|fight]].<ref name="DOU" />

After securing a ridge, Skywalker was recalled to the Republic [[Capital/Legends|capital]], [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], and was replaced by [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[General/Legends|General]] [[Pong Krell/Legends|Pong Krell]].<ref name="DOU" /> Krell, a [[Besalisk/Legends|Besalisk]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]], was known for the high casualty rate of the clone [[Trooper/Legends|troopers]] under his command but also for amassing many victories throughout the war.<ref name="SWEKrell">{{SWE|characters|generalpongkrell|General Pong Krell}}</ref> The general immediately ordered Oz and the 501st to move directly toward the Umbaran capital. After arriving at a [[Umbara capital main road/Legends|highway]] that led to the capital, Krell told Rex that he would not proceed with Skywalker's plan of capturing the city through the use of surgical strikes, and instead wanted his troops to attack the city in a full frontal assault. The 501st [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]], including Oz, would use the highway and would not retreat if they met resistance from the Umbarans. Unbeknownst to the Republic clones, the enemy had [[Mine/Legends|mined]] the road. After some time, Oz, together with fellow trooper [[Ringo/Legends|Ringo]], stepped on such a mine, and both were [[Death/Legends|killed]] in the ensuing explosion. Two clones who checked the bodies then reported that Oz and Ringo were dead.<ref name="DOU" />

==Personality and traits==
While under captivity on Ereesus, Oz revealed no information to the enemy due to his training.<ref name="Speaking Silently" /> Oz was unable to recognize that the road on Umbara was mined, and as a result he died when he stepped on one of the explosives.<ref name="DOU" /> As a clone of Jango Fett, Oz likewise stood 1.83 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] tall.<ref name="clone troopers" />

==Equipment==
During the battle on Umbara, Oz wore a set of [[Phase II clone trooper armor/Legends|Phase II clone trooper armor]] that was customized with the [[Color/Legends|blue]] markings of the 501st Legion, his [[Legion/Legends|unit]].<ref name="DOU" />

==Behind the scenes==
Oz first appeared in "[[Darkness on Umbara]]," the first episode of the Umbara arc of the [[The Clone Wars: Season Four|fourth season]] of the television series ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]''.<ref name="Explore: Darkness on Umbara">{{SW|url=series/clone-wars/darkness-on-umbara-episode-guide|text="Darkness on Umbara" Episode Guide &#124; The Clone Wars}}</ref> The episode aired on [[October 28]], [[2011]].<ref name="Insider 129: Launch Pad">{{InsiderCite|129|Launchpad}}</ref> Oz was also mentioned in the episode's corresponding [[The Clone Wars Episode Guides|online guide]] on [[StarWars.com]].<ref name="Explore: Darkness on Umbara" /> In [[2013]], Oz had a short appearance in ''[[Speaking Silently]]'', a short story written by [[Tom Hodges]] and published in [[Star Wars Insider 139|''Star Wars Insider'' 139]].<ref name="Speaking Silently" />
